description: An astronaut stands alone on a barren lunar landscape in a wide shot.

spec.subject: A lone astronaut in a white EVA suit with scuffed thermal layers, a reflective gold visor, bulky life-support backpack, and dust-coated boots
spec.setting: Barren lunar surface under a black sky, with gray regolith, scattered small rocks in the foreground, low rolling ridges in the midground, and a distant crater rim on the horizon; no atmosphere, no vegetation, no visible structures
spec.action: Standing still and facing into the open landscape
spec.camera_angle: three-quarter front, eye level, extreme wide shot, 24mm lens, the astronaut placed small in the lower center of frame
spec.lighting: hard sunlight from high camera-left, crisp shadows falling to camera-right, high-contrast monochrome-gray palette with bright specular highlights on the suit
spec.style: digital capture with fine grain, neutral-to-cool grade, realistic lunar-surface detail and stark contrast

human.critique: dim soft cabin light, not hard sunlight
